from pyspark.sql import functions as F, Window
from functools import reduce
import re

# ---------- config ----------
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"          # fill in
BASE        = f"abfss://apmt-elz@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
SOURCE_DIR  = f"{BASE}/bronze/stackconformitycsvs/archive"
TARGET_PATH = f"{BASE}/gold/conformities_new"
DRY_RUN     = False                              # True = build + check only, no write

REQUIRED = ["ContainerNo","StackingFactor","BlockType","Eq Type","Equipment Class","YardRow",
            "Cat","Sts","SectionFactor","Outbound Carrier","Current POD","Line",
            "CurrentPosition","Special Stow1","Special Stow2"]
RENAME = {"Eq Type":"Eq_Type","Equipment Class":"Equipment_Class","Outbound Carrier":"Outbound_Carrier",
          "Current POD":"Current_POD","Special Stow1":"Special_Stow1","Special Stow2":"Special_Stow2"}

def clean(name):                                # strip [ ], BOM, spaces around the name
    return re.sub(r"[\[\]\ufeff]", "", name).strip()

# ---------- list files ----------
hpath = spark._jvm.org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path(SOURCE_DIR)
fs = hpath.getFileSystem(spark._jsc.hadoopConfiguration())
files = sorted(str(s.getPath()) for s in fs.listStatus(hpath) if str(s.getPath()).lower().endswith(".csv"))

# ---------- read each file by header name ----------
frames, problems = [], []
for path in files:
    fname = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    m = re.search(r"_(\d{6})\.csv$", fname, re.I)
    if not m:
        problems.append((fname, "no ddMMyy in file name")); continue
    raw = (spark.read.option("header", True).option("inferSchema", False)
           .option("quote", '"').option("escape", "\\").csv(path))
    df = raw.toDF(*[clean(c) for c in raw.columns])
    missing = [c for c in REQUIRED if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        problems.append((fname, f"missing {missing}")); continue
    df = df.select(*[F.col(f"`{c}`").alias(RENAME.get(c, c)) for c in REQUIRED]) \
           .withColumn("FileDate", F.lit(fname)) \
           .withColumn("Date", F.to_date(F.lit(m.group(1)), "ddMMyy"))
    frames.append(df)

print("Files read:", len(frames), "| Problems:", problems)
src = reduce(lambda a, b: a.unionByName(b), frames)

# ---------- derivedColumn1 ----------
fcl, mty = F.col("Sts") == "FCL", F.col("Sts") == "MTY"
d = (src
  .withColumn("Pos_WO_Tier", F.when(F.col("CurrentPosition").rlike(r"\d$"),
                F.expr("substring(CurrentPosition, 1, length(CurrentPosition) - 2)"))
              .otherwise(F.col("CurrentPosition")))
  .withColumn("Week", F.when(F.dayofweek("Date") == 1, F.weekofyear("Date") + 1)
              .otherwise(F.weekofyear("Date")).cast("int"))
  .withColumn("StackingFactor_der",
      F.when(fcl, F.concat("Outbound_Carrier", F.lit("/"), "Current_POD", F.lit("/"),
                           F.coalesce("Special_Stow1", F.lit("")), F.lit("/"),
                           F.coalesce("Special_Stow2", F.lit("")), F.lit("/"), "Equipment_Class"))
       .when(mty, F.concat("Equipment_Class", F.lit("/"), "Line"))
       .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("string")))
  .withColumn("SectionFactor_der",
      F.when(fcl, F.concat("Outbound_Carrier", F.lit("/"), "Current_POD", F.lit("/"), "Sts"))
       .when(mty, F.concat("Equipment_Class", F.lit("/"), "Line"))
       .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("string"))))

# inner joins in the flow drop null keys - replicate that
d = d.filter(F.col("Date").isNotNull() & F.col("Pos_WO_Tier").isNotNull() & F.col("YardRow").isNotNull())

# ---------- window1/aggregate1 + window2/aggregate2 (same as rank + max > 1) ----------
ws  = Window.partitionBy("Date", "Pos_WO_Tier")
wy  = Window.partitionBy("Date", "YardRow")
d = (d
  .withColumn("stackrank",   F.rank().over(ws.orderBy(F.col("StackingFactor").asc_nulls_first())))
  .withColumn("sectionrank", F.rank().over(wy.orderBy(F.col("SectionFactor").asc_nulls_first())))
  .withColumn("Stack_confirmty",    F.when(F.max("stackrank").over(ws) > 1, "Mix").otherwise("Pure"))
  .withColumn("Section_conformity", F.when(F.max("sectionrank").over(wy) > 1, "Mix").otherwise("Pure")))

# ---------- filter1 ----------
d = d.filter(F.col("ContainerNo").isNotNull() & (F.col("ContainerNo") != "")
             & ~F.col("ContainerNo").rlike(r"^\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}"))

# ---------- per-file reconciliation ----------
(src.groupBy("FileDate").agg(F.count("*").alias("rows_in"))
   .join(d.groupBy("FileDate").agg(F.count("*").alias("rows_out")), "FileDate", "left")
   .orderBy("FileDate").show(100, False))

# ---------- select1 + select2 (sink schema) ----------
out = d.select(
  F.col("ContainerNo").alias("Container_No"), F.col("StackingFactor").alias("Stacking_Factor"),
  "Eq_Type", "BlockType", F.col("CurrentPosition").alias("Current_position"),
  F.col("YardRow").alias("Yard_Row"), "Cat", "Sts", F.col("SectionFactor").alias("Section_Factor"),
  "Pos_WO_Tier", "Date", "Week", "StackingFactor_der", "SectionFactor_der",
  "Stack_confirmty", "Section_conformity", "Line")

# ---------- write: replace only the dates being loaded (no duplicates on rerun) ----------
if not DRY_RUN:
    # keep the existing Delta table structure: same columns, order and types
    target_schema = spark.read.format("delta").load(TARGET_PATH).schema
    aligned = out.select([
        (F.col(f.name) if f.name in out.columns else F.lit(None))
            .cast(f.dataType).alias(f.name)
        for f in target_schema
    ])

    (aligned.write.format("delta")
        .mode("overwrite")                    # replace all rows
        .option("overwriteSchema", "false")   # never change the table schema
        .save(TARGET_PATH))

    print("Rows written:", spark.read.format("delta").load(TARGET_PATH).count())
